title: Define the core problem
description: Share the user problem, target audience, and success metrics for the app.

title: List must-have features
description: Separate MVP features from later-phase ideas so we can scope delivery clearly.

title: Provide brand assets
description: Logo, colors, fonts, and any existing UI references or competitor apps you like.

title: Platforms & integrations
description: iOS, Android, web  -  plus payments, maps, auth, CRM, analytics, or third-party APIs.

title: Data & admin needs
description: User roles, dashboards, content management, reporting, and storage expectations.

title: Timeline & budget range
description: Target launch date, launch markets, and an approximate budget band for planning.

title: Security & compliance
description: Any requirements for privacy, encryption, accessibility, or industry regulations.

title: Ownership & support
description: Who owns accounts, app store publishing, and post-launch maintenance preferences.
